title: Scoring Recovery-Time Agent Security: Proposals, Effects, and Retry Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2611.31318v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A timed-out tool write may be absent, committed, or still in flight. Evaluating an agent only on whether its goal exists can hide harmful recovery actions: auditing 12 supplied traces changes apparent completion from 10/12 to 8/12. We introduce an executable evaluation that separately records tool proposals, runtime decisions, and committed effects. In 3,456 model episodes, the original task wording produces only 39/576 valid recoveries when the initial write is absent; a combined clarification produces 576/576. A further 1,584 episodes test stronger attacks and separate the effect definition from the recovery recipe with three rollouts per absent-state cell. Definition alone yields 276/288 valid recoveries; recipe alone yields 288/288. For Luna, malicious text is associated with 11.1 percentage points fewer valid recoveries under both original and definition-only wording, an availability signal limited by shared tasks and templates. T

translated_title: 恢复期智能体安全性评分：提案、效果与重试指令
translated_abstract: 工具写入超时后，该写入可能处于缺失、已提交或仍在传输中的状态。仅依据目标是否存在来评估智能体，可能会掩盖有害的恢复行为：对提供的12条轨迹进行审计后，表观完成率从10/12变为8/12。我们提出了一种可执行的评估方法，分别记录工具提案、运行时决策和已提交的效果。在3,456次模型实验中，当初始写入缺失时，原始任务措辞仅产生39/576次有效恢复；而组合澄清说明则产生576/576次有效恢复。另外1,584次实验测试了更强的攻击，并在每个缺失状态单元进行三次rollout的条件下，将效果定义与恢复配方分离。仅使用定义可产生276/288次有效恢复；仅使用配方可产生288/288次有效恢复。对于Luna模型，恶意文本在原始措辞和仅定义措辞下均与有效恢复减少11.1个百分点相关，这是一个受共享任务和模板限制的可用性信号。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种可执行的恢复期智能体安全性评估方法，通过分别记录工具提案、运行时决策与已提交效果，揭示了仅按目标完成度评估会掩盖有害恢复行为，并证明清晰的效果定义与恢复指令能显著提升超时写入场景下的有效恢复率。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces an executable evaluation that separately scores agent recovery-time security by recording tool proposals, runtime decisions, and committed effects, showing that naive goal-existence checks mask harmful recovery actions and that explicit effect definitions and recovery instructions dramatically improve valid recovery rates after timed-out tool writes.
